svg.title: Snowcapped mountain, evergreen forest and lake — vector reconstruction
svg.desc: A manual vector reconstruction of the user-supplied isolated landscape. All artwork is editable SVG path geometry organized into named layers and tree groups. No embedded images, automatic bitmap traces, text, fonts, filters, or raster effects. Transparent background; no badge holder, lettering, border, or added sky. An independent redraw, not an official or exact original source file.

g.inkscape:label: Snowcaps · left and right independently editable
